balls.text: shortish and outside off, looks to stand and slog towards leg. Only gets an inside edge towards deep square leg. They're racing back for the second, this is a good, flat through and Morris hasn't made it back
148kph, runs at the bowler to swing blindly. Back of a length delivery outside off beats him. Watson comes up to talk to him.
147kph, cramps him with a quick short ball at the body, swung away towards short fine leg. Inside edge, off the body more, I think
fuller and outside off, slugs the slower ball to long-on
flat-bats a shortish delivery down the ground to long-off

there it is! Spreads his arms aloft towards the dressing room, who are standing up and so is this crowd. Full and wide outside off, slashed over short third man and punched the air immediately after making contact. This is some innings!
full and outside off, sliced to the sweeper on the off side to retain strike. He's on 98
full toss on middle and leg, swiped to long-on
looks for the yorker on off stump, sliced through the covers
this is length and Watson has pinged the second tier in the stands. Went forward, and unleashed a full swing of the arms. Massive hit!
steps down the track while making room to meet the intended yorker on the full and slices it to deep third man
terrific yorker on the base middle, dug out for only a single into the covers
fuller delivery outside off, Karun goes for a booming drive through the off side. All he gets is an outside edge through to the keeper.
149kph, he's scooped the ball between his left leg and the off stump! Runs across, is stymied by the length being that full. Still manages to get a fine enough edge to scurry away
shortish and outside off, goes for a front-foot swipe towards midwicket. But the slower pace beats him. Only gets an inside edge to long-on
moves away to leg and Umesh follows him again, pushed through the covers
moves outside leg, Umesh follows him, Karun looks for a slice through point. Gets a very thick outside edge and it scurries away to the third man boundary
back of a length and outside off, slapped to the left of long-off
has managed to dupe the batsman with the slower ball. This at 97.8. Heaves a sigh of relief, and a signal of his exertions, as Karun goes for a slog to the fuller ball outside off and misses
full toss on middle, Watson looks to heave it down to long-on
another offcutter, Watson did away with his front leg, used the room he has created and thumped the ball through extra cover. Russell's speed is easily bested. Rushing towards a ton!
overpitched outside off, thumped down the ground. Could have been another boundary but Russell is prowling that area and he slides to his right to save it
shortish and outside off, slapped to deep point. Slower ball again, but not lobbed up full

take that, slower ball! It's been a go-to to every bowler in the IPL, but this time a batsman has picked it early, waiting on the trigger position with his high backlift, and slammed it over the top. Only 81 kph

full and wide, Watson has lashed it over point. Stays beside the line of the wider delivery and smears it over the top. Great effort from Pandey on the boundary, running to his left and diving full-length, but he can't get there

dropped by Mahmood at mid-off. Came straight at him as Karun picked up an overpitched delivery and drilled it down the ground. Doesn't get the elevation. The fielder had to move to his right a bit and dive forward, but this really should have been taken
just a bit shortish on middle and leg, worked behind square leg
141kph, shortish and outside off, another slash, another miss.
short and wide outside off, Watson is rooted to his crease as he goes for a slash. Morkel's pace is making him nervous
145kph, good length ball on off stump, lots of pace behind it as well. Watson blocks
full on middle and leg, flicked to deep midwicket for a couple
back of a length and outside off, tries to defend and gets an inside edge towards fine leg
shortish on middle and leg, clipped to deep square leg. End of a pretty good spell from Russell: 4-0-31-3
goes short on middle, seeking to cramp the batsman up. But Karun sways his torso inside the line and ramps the ball over the keeper. Beautiful stroke
fuller delivery on off stump, pushed to long-on
full on middle, Faulkner stays deep in his crease and looks for a heave seeking to clear the boundary. But he hasn't got as much as he'd like. Long-on runs to his right and takes a clean catch
another short ball, but this one rises a bit higher and Faulkner doesn't want to meddle with it. Good zip from Russell, and he had a deep midwicket around as well
banged in short, Faulkner says he's had enough of poking around and pulls. Looks to hit it so hard, and has a boundary well in front of square
in the slot and Watson's power is unveiled. Gets forward to the pitch and lifts it impressively over the sightscreen
slips through his hands and presents a very wide full toss. Not bothered with
tapped down the ground to long-off. Faulkner's doing his bit well, rotating strike. but Shakib's bringing things back with his changes of pace
set up deep in his crease and slaps the short ball to long-off
flighted only a shade outside off, But Watson has lunged forward and sliced it through point. Picked the gap wonderfully well
flighted on off stump, driven through to long-off
flighted on middle, Faulkner pushes it back at the bowler
back of a length and outside off, left quite well alone. And that's also the time out

saw the length ball, thought it was there to be heaved away over leg again. But he's into the shot too early. Gets a leading edge and the catch balloons to point. Cross-seamer works for Russell, cross-bat doesn't for Samson. Royals giving gifts to KKR
that's a full toss, and he's swiped it to the wide long-on boundary. Pressed forward and sort of whipped it. Powerful wristwork
waits on the back foot for a shortish delivery and tucks it towards midwicket
too quick for Watson. He was loading up for a pull, but the short ball skids onto him. Gets an inside edge towards midwicket
shortish and outside off, back cut to the right of deep third man
darted in on middle and leg, he backs away and punches with the horizontal bat
flighted down the leg side, goes for a sweep and misses. No point in appealing, but Shakib and Uthappa do
down the track, but he can't reach the pitch. Lovely bowling from Shakib, pulling the length back and curtailing the batsman.
flighted on middle, defended after he tries to make some room and decides not to take advantage of it
steps forward, and a little way outside off. Smeared through the covers
deftly done! Good length ball outside off, Samson plays it very late and uses the  open face. Gets it fine of Yusuf, but he is able to catch up with it
shortish and outside off, Samson watches it and taps it on top of the bounce and sends the ball behind square. Like the ball was some good boy and he was patting his head

that's an absolute shocker! A dumbfounded Smith is looking at the umpire for a no-ball. But this should be out. A full toss has been flicked straight at short fine leg. Doesn't look like he'll be saved. Smith will be kicking himself all the way back to the pavilion
good length ball outside off, Smith cleared his front leg for a big slog through midwicket. Only gets an inside edge onto his pads
full on leg stump, whipped towards long-on. A little way to his right
stands up tall against a shortish delivery outside off, punched through the covers
shortish and outside off, run towards point and he's snagged another rapid single
flicked away through square leg. That's his fifty, and he's looking good for much more
holds it back and manages to snag the outside edge as Smith steps down again. Closed the face too early, and gets off strike with a single to third man
good length ball draws Smith to play away from the body, pushed into the covers
shortish and outside off, punched to long-off
picked up and smashed down the ground! Saw the flight on it, loves the width on it, and unleashes. Massive backlift, massive followthrough, massive shot
reaches the pitch after using his feet and drives wide of long-on
tossed up well wide of leg stump from around the wicket, goes for a sweep and misses. So does the keeper.
gets down the track and whips a good length ball past midwicket's right. And there's no one behind him. The batting in this match has been quite captivating. Conjures a boundary
bangs it in short, and Smith's split long leg and deep fine leg. Moves away outside off, as you do, and pulls on top of the bounce and uses the wrists to keep the ball down and in the gap
full on off stump, pushed to long-off
gets up off his toes to block a short ball rising above his stomach
shortish on middle and leg, swivel pulled to deep square leg
shortish on middle and leg, defused into the midwicket region
short delivery, he winds up and flat-bats it towards long-on. Only Smith's legs get in the way even as he tries not to. Hits him despite doing the splits
stays back to a reasonably fuller ball - playing the flat trajectory - and cuts into the covers
shortish and outside off, cracked to the sweeper again
stays back to a short ball and cuts to the sweeper
gets forward towards the pitch of the ball and blocks
gets down the track to the spinner straight away, nudged to long-on

you can't look any prettier while getting out. Leans forward for a cover drive again, and it wasn't like it was an overpitched delivery. Lovely timing. But then he is eager to get back on strike. Watson gets through for a couple of steps and then realises the danger. Sells his partner down the river.
lots of width, this one was a shade fuller too and Rahane has flayed it away through point. Stunning timing. Great intent. Simple cricketing shots
and the home crowd gets what it wants! This is a poor delivery, lobbed up in the slot, allowed Rahane to step forward and mow it over long-on. Huuuuuge hit.

shortish and outside off, Rahane is on the balls of his feet as he punches into the covers. And then looks up (I imagine) with a smile at the ump signalling a no-ball. Free hit time. DJ calls for a chant: "We want? Sixer!"
fullish on leg stump, flicked to the man at deep midwicket
goes wide of the crease for a shortish delivery on middle and leg, tucked away through midwicket
looks for the fuller ball on off stump, dug out into the covers
flighted on middle, driven smartly to mid-off
down the track, not quite at the pitch, but it's not turning either. Hit through the line and lifted over the bowler's head. Massive hit
drops it short and  Watson has hammered it through to the deep square leg boundary, just in front of square. Asking to be hit and obliged
tossed up on leg stump, eased through to the man at deep midwicket again. Watson struck it softly and placed it well enough for a couple again
goes back and flicks a length ball through to deep midiwcket, and they've hared across for a couple. Rahane's call, and he's in with ample time
a bit short and Watson backs away to cut into the covers
back of a length on off stump, defended
shortish on middle and leg, nudged towards midwicket
slower ball outside off, Rahane gets down and runs it through to third man. Russell keeps it to only a single
this is short, and Watson is too eager on the pull. Punches the bat at the non-strikers' at having secured only a single. Bad mis-hit
good length but it's been pummeled! This pitch is wonderful for batting, the bounce is true, swing is absent and Watson presses forward and thumps down the ground
stays back to open the face on top of the bounce and runs a shortish delivery to third man on the boundary
good length ball on off stump, Watson softens his grip and defends towards the covers. Quick single, easily taken. No surprise there, Rahane was the quickest in the Indian team in a 100 yard dash
shortish on off stump, Rahane lets it come on and flicks it behind square leg
fuller delivery on off stump, pushes down the pitch
that one seamed! And oddly, it was a cross-seamer. A little movement away but Rahane rides it with the angled face and caresses it past the keeper
stays beside the shortish ball and dabs it behind point. It just scurries away, Chawla at deep third man has a lot of work to do. Runs to his right, dives, and saves a boundary

he's just giving too much room and Rahane has slashed it past point. The pace at which the ball is screaming off the bat is stunning. Pandey had to dive to his left, did so reasonably well, and even got a hand to it... Very tough to call that a drop

full on middle and leg, Watson is caught in the crease and plays an uncertain prod. Like he was going for a flick and then decided he needed to use a straighter bat. Ends up with possibly an inside edge onto pad to ruin the appeal
good length and outside off, slid off the open face to deep third man. Lovely batting from these two. They've assessed the situation so early and so well. Not fooled by the grass on the pitch
good length ball outside off, Watson steps forward and pushes into the coveres. Surya isn't quick enough to stop the single
short and a touch wide, the bounce on this pitch can be trusted like a best buddy, rides to third man again
shortish and outside off, waits on the back foot and runs it towards third man

and that's a rocket! Surya is the man at cover point, he only had to dive to his right to stop that. But the power Watson derives from his front foot, especially with the ball not swinging, is stunning
that's a sizzler! He saw the width, he loves it and lashes the ball over point. And it carries all the way. Well, he did say a six is a six no matter if it just clears the ropes or soars through it
shortish on middle and leg, nudged behind square leg. There's cover in the deep
a shade shortish and wider, and slower too perhaps, judging from Rahane going for the cut too early and failing to adjust. Beaten. Only a subtle change of pace though
slips down leg, and he helps the 142 kph delivery off to the fine leg boundary. Lots of bounce for the tall Morkel and this whistles off the thigh pad
stays back and slices the shortish delivery towards point. Angled bat again
141kph, ample bounce, makes Rahane leap off his feet to get on top of the ball. Then taps it through third man with an open face. Neatly done for a couple
hits the back of a length again and keeps Watson quiet
on the pads this time, and all he had to do was pick the gap past mid-on's right. Terrific timing, didn't look to overhit the ball. Neither did he drag that front foot that annoying bit across
and that's the result. Hit clean through the line. A fuller delivery and Watson loves lunging forward and thumps it through the covers
tests him on the off-stump corridor, Watson doesn't bother with it. Just checking if the ball is swinging. Not quite
keeps it tight on middle, Watson is happy to block it down the pitch
back of a length on off stump, Rahane is watchful as he plays it under his eyes and dabs behind point

well bowled, spears it into the blockhole and Morken can only nudge it towards the leg side. Royals are through to the playoffs and the defending champions will need to rely on other results to keep their tournament alive
low full toss on off stump, thumped to long-off all along the ground
hits the blockhole on off stump, only a single into the covers
full on off stump, heaved away wide of long-on for a couple. Appeal for a run-out, but Morkel is quite safe
full on leg stump, clubbed to long-on
good length ball, Shakib goes for a swing and he gets it pretty high on the bat. Smith runs in from long-on and takes a simple catch. Buuuuut, Umesh has crossed over and will be on strike
through the covers again! And this is better too, picks up the overpitched delivery and lifts it over extra cover. Great strike
low full toss has been smeared through the off side. Umesh is playing an absolute gem. Places it so well, finds the gap through the covers and makes sure the sweeper can't do anything
top up the wide counter again. Looks for the yorker outside off but the ball slips out of his hands again
fuller and wide of off stump, Samson goes up in appeal to try and ward the umpire away from calling a wide. But that was inside the tram lines
length ball on off stump, Umesh clears the front leg and wallops it over long-on. Knight Riders are roaring back, through their No. 10 batsman
cracked away to the point boundary! Umesh is still fighting. Royals are still bowling poorly. Short ball, ample width, and it's been taken advantage of
length on off stump, Shakib slogs away to long-on
misses a full toss outside off
needs the towel from the umpire again as another fuller delivery slides miles wide of off stump
yorker on off stump, dug out
fuller delivery outside off, but just inside that wide line. One of the few. Umesh slashes and misses
how quickly did that travel? offers up an overpitched dleivery and Umesh has wound up and hammered it to the straight boundary
fuller delivery outside off, sliced away but only as far as point. Simple catch, simply taken
full on off stump, pushed to long-on
goes full, but his radar is still bonkers. Shakib accepts the millionth wide, down the leg side
full on off stump, hammered back at the bowler. He just about gets a hand on it and deflects it to long-on
slower ball outside off, Shakib was looking at third man but his slice doesn't connect

that's a stunner at long-on! This had gone miles in the air, he had a lot of time to contemplate how the match would change depending on this catch. Runs to his right, judges it wonderuflly well. And eventually he pouches it very safely. Goes for a length ball outside off but the slog doesn't come off
hits the fuller ball on off stump, drilled back at the bowler

shortish and outside off, cut away powerfully towards the third man boundary. Ankit Sharma is down there, who nearly overruns the ball. Manages to recover quickly enough to keep it in the field of play
just back of a length and outside off, slapped to long-on
slips it down the other side this time. The famous Faulkner slower balls and coming off completely wrong. As he walks back, he grabs the umpire's kerchief. Struggle gripping the ball?
appears the back of the hand slower ball, which meanders away to the off side. The batsman leaves and collects a wide
manages to hit the wide yorker well. Jams the bat down to try and slice it towards point. Only gets an inside edge to the keeper
smoked a length ball to the deep midwicket boundary! Picked up the length ball and swings it away. Clean strike
back of a length and outside off, Azhar pushes it to point
banged in short, and it soards over the batsman's head outside off --- adding to the 20-plus extras
back of a length and outside off, Azhar is the new man in and he plays an iffy sort of dab towards third man. Misses
right down the throat of long-off. Royals think they have the game. It was a length ball on and around off stump, Pathan makes room to hammer it over Kulkarni, but isn't able to.
that time he gets the wide yorker perfectly right. Yusuf merely watches it pass
another one, Royals have been quite ordinary with the ball so far. Quite rattled by the power of the KKR power-hitters
full and wide, Yusuf reaches as far out as he can for the flay over the covers.
and now some insult to injury. Runs away outside off to scoop a fuller ball on off stump past short fine leg. Amazing connection
dances down to pick up a length and slower ball and then exploits the room he had given himself. Drilled through extra with great authority
low full toss outside off, driven to the sweeper on the off side
backs away against a back of a length ball on leg stump, can't get the power behind a pull. Splices it to long-on
good length ball outside off, Yusuf slices it to deep point
stays a little too far way on leg stump to reach the short delivery outside off with the horizontal bat
shortish and outside off, Shakib is rooted to his crease as he goes for a slash and misses
good length ball on off stump, defended

that's an absolute corker! It's back of a length, it straightens away off the seam, Yadav has to play. He does so with a nervy push. Shaves the outside edge and carries through to the keeper. Bounce, pace, movement. The good old triple threat
a hint of width and it's cut away through to deep point

that's an outside edge, and it's travelled as far as long-off. It was fuller on middle, Russell is livid with himself as he clears the front leg and looks to thump it towards long-on again only to mis-hit it. Big strike for Royals
shortish and outside off, dabbed to deep third mna
short on leg stump, tucked away to short fine leg
back of a length on middle, swiped away to long-on
attempts a back of the hand slower ball and ends up a loopy full toss well wide of off stump
doesn't matter if its full either. Clears that front leg and assaults the width on offer. Slammed through the covers and it reaches the boundary before anyone can blink

cleared the stadium! Soars well over the roof beyond midwicket! Humongous hit, and guess what the length is? Short and sat up for Russell as he pulls off the front foot. He's playing an absolute blinder
another slower ball, with a little width, slapped through the covers
starts with an offcutter at the body of Russell, can't flick it away far enough because the connection wasn't with the bat
full and outside off, goes for a slash through the covers again. Gets an inside edge onto his pads and Yusuf drags him through for a single
fuller and wider outside off, Russell was going for another smear over the covers. Misses
on the roof! Clears that front leg and smears the fuller delivery into orbit. Has all the room to free his arms and his power is absolutely stunning. Length ball, duly dealt with
length ball, well wide of off stump, slashed away over the covers
that time it is full, and it is skewed away towards third man. Faulkner rushes in, hoping to take a catch, but the ball dies on him. Did well to get his body behind it though
sits up for Russell to pummel to the long-on boundary. They are bowling short as if they'd be punished if the pitched the ball up
fuller delivery outside off, hammered to long-on
good length ball on off stump, Yusuf was trying to slide it to third man but it's not possible. Settles for a single to point. No room on offer
shortish and outside off, punched behind point
slips away down the leg side, Russell was looking flick it to long leg but misses.
goes for a slash and miss

dropped by Faulkner in his followthrough. That's a shortish delivery on middle, Russell goes for a heave but he gets it off the splice. The bowler sticks his hand out, but that didn't stick. Also, the sightscreen behind him was illuminated with an ad. Hard to spot
good length ball enjoys an outside edge to deep third man. Keep the ball up and it's moving just enough. Can't understand their short ball ploy
in the slot and it's drilled down the ground to long-on. Good work from Watson, running around to his left
bowl it full and he gets swing! Beating Yusuf is so joyous as Binny and Samson appeal! No bat involved as he goes for a flick absent footwork. Lovely movement
another short ball, Yusuf waits for it, that big backlift is scary, and he pummels the ball through midwicket. Simple
banged in short, why would he do that? Yusuf has pulled it well over the short fine leg fielder. Help yourself bowling from Royals
good length ball, straightening a touch. Yusuf dabs it into the leg side for a single. But Binny cuts across and keeps it to nothing
goes short on middle and leg, quite short that time, Russell is happy to duck under it
shortish and outside off, slapped away to the  sweeper. Binny slides around and keeps it to only two

but when it is short, he is murderous. Not really all that short, and it's on middle. But that preference for the back foot and his furious power allows him to pull through midwicket and the ball reaches the long boundary in a trice
no slip, and the outside edge runs away past the diving keeper! Stuck on the back foot again to a fuller delivery that straightens rather late. Looking scratchy now
back of a length and outside off, Russell is lead-footed as he pokes with an angled bat. Beaten on the away swing
straight to cover! Seems the slower ball has worked out. It was a length ball, on leg stump. Pandey had made room for the slash and picks out the fielder
makes a bit of room and cuts a shortish delivery through to deep point
full on middle, whipped to wide long-on
can't bowl short at his pace and Yusuf has thumped it to the midwicket boundary. He does have issues with the  short ball, not not at medium pace. Pulled viciously
shortish and on off stump, tapped to long-off. Not timed really
he's playing on Watson's lack of pace, back of a length delivery has been pulled off the front foot well in front of square
lovely seam position, curved towards the slips, if they had been there. Hits a good length and swings away past the outside edge of Pandey's slash
backs away from a length ball and slashes it through to the sweeper
back of a length and on off stump, slid down to deep third man
good length and outside off, pushed to long-off

fuller ball on off stump, Yusuf goes for a huge slash over over the covers. Binny is the man rushing in from the boundary, dives forward looking for the catch, but it bounces before him and slips away to the boundary

banged in short, Yusuf goes for the pull. Looks quite awkward doing it and gets a top edge that flies towards the square leg boundary. Hooda is running to his left, Sran was racing to his left from long leg. Hooda goes for a the catch, but it slips past his hands and his momentum takes him into a horribly collision into Sran. Hooda's looking quite out of it. The physio's checking his reflexes, seeing if he isn't too dazed. Looks a bit of an issue here. Still sitting against the boundary, having some liquid. Breathing hard
fuller delivery outside off, Pandey gets a toe-end to a swipe and finds a single at long-on
full on off stump, heaved away to deep midwicket and that's the time out

backs away to slice a back of a length delivery from well outside leg to point. Good work from the two men there, but Rahane's throw misses the stumps when the batsmen weren't particularly interested in a run. Overthrows allow them the luxury
good length ball on middle and leg, turned away to midwicket
soars over the keeper again! Hits the middle of the deck, Yusuf ducks immediately, and Samson has no chance
straightens! But yusuf is solidly behind it. Keeps to his crease for a good length ball that Kulkarni jags away towards off stump
back of a length and outside off, pushed into the covers
gets up off his toes and turns a shortish delivery off his hips to long leg
fuller delivery curves away from Yusuf's front foot drive through the covers. Morris is getting the ball to talk just enough
fulish on middle and leg, goes for a flick, doesn't connect. Single off the pads
shortish on middle, Yusuf nudges it in front of square
leaps away from the outside edge of Yusuf's poke. Back of a length and outside off, moves away off the seam
shortish and sliding down, Yusuf has stepped inisde the line and dabbed it to long leg. Wonderful shot
good length ball seaming away, Pathan looks to bash it down the ground and misses
shortish on middle, goes for a pull. It's mistimed and shoots towards long leg
what the heck! That hit the middle of the pitch and leaped about 20 feet in the air. Samson needed to be on stilts to get that. Soars away to the boundary behind him
good length ball on leg stump, cramps Pandey for room and taps it to mid-on
pulls, and he mistimes it, and yet beats mid-on! Swivels with the shot, struck a little high on the bat, but the ball beats Morris to his left
punched into the turf and that helps him leap over point. Brilliant timing from Pandey as he makes an effort to stay beside the ball and slices it away
shortish on middle, pushes him off his feet for a flick to midwicket
shortish and outside off, slapped towards mid-off

a second major blow for Kolkata, Uthappa is gone, holes out to mid-off, looking to clear the man in the ring but he doesn't get enough power on that as it hits high on the bat, the ball gently flies towards Smith, he doesn't drop that, can Kolkata recover from these two big early losses?
similar length, Pandey backs away from the stumps and guides that towards third man
angling in, short of length ball, Pandey is rapped on the pads
on the pads, fine leg in the ring, Uthappa was already thinking of the esy boundary he was going to get, he should have put that away, instead he can't get bat on ball, and can only get a leg-bye
driven on the up, that was a terrific shot from Uthappa, just takes a smal step forward and drives through cover, not looking to power that, just timing and placement
angling in towadrs the pads, pushed towards midwicket for a single
pitched up and well outside off, thumped past cover point for four
short of length and just outside off, Pandey pulls it gently towards midwicket for a single
pitched up and outside off, driven crisply towards cover, Hooda dives to his right to cut that off
shortish once more, moves in a touch, Pandey was down the track and looking to make room, Pandey wanted to cut that through cover, but Bran gaves him no room, so Pandey can't get much power
shorter this time, Pandey pulls, not with any authority, the ball rolls towards midwicket
starts well, with a short of length ball from over the wicket, defended for a single
short ball, came quickly onto Gambhir, who was forced into an awkward position, he still plays the pull, top edges it and that loops to Binny at backward square leg, massive wicket this
shorter and angling in, Uthappa plays it with soft hands, drops the ball to the left of the bowler and zips through for a single
full and well outside off, Uthappa likes it there, chases it and drives it superbly in front of cover point for four
short of length ball around off stump, Gambhir pushes this towards cover and takes a single
length ball just outside leg stump, Gambhir looks to tuck that away but can't get bat on ball
this one is wild, way down the leg side, well done by the keeper Samson to collect that, diving acrobatically before quickly getting up and hurling the ball at the stumps
